notes.subject: ekaḥ mo'ed
notes.rationale: 'go tswelela nako ye e kgethwilwego' — LXX e hlalosa 'ka komedi', KJV 'go amogela phuthego'; ke Lentšu la Yahwe le bolelago fela

notes.subject: anokhi
notes.rationale: 'nna ka norena' — pronoun e tiilega bakeng sa go gatelela gore ke Yahwe feela a kahlolago

notes.subject: ka toka
notes.rationale: meisharim — 'bokagodimo', go se fetoge; e šumišitšwe bakeng sa kahlolo ya go loka

translation: Ge nka tswelela nako ye e kgethwilwego, nna ka norena ke a kahlola ka toka.
